whatThisIs: Master register of every connector and connection used by every flow action and trigger found in this repository. Generated by scripts/build-connector-register.mjs from every tracked file and archive member — do not edit by hand.

howToRead.artefact: One flow definition, package, scope or fragment as a file carries it. The same flow can appear in several artefacts (deployed export, package zip, designer-paste, run capture); each is recorded separately and `family` says which kind it is. `derived: true` marks artefacts generated from another artefact in this repository.
howToRead.actionRow: One action or trigger that binds a connector: managed connectors (OpenApiConnection / ApiConnection / webhooks) and the built-in network surfaces (HTTP, Request trigger, Response, Recurrence, child-flow calls). Control and data operations are not rows; they are counted in each artefact's typeInventory so the walk is shown complete.
howToRead.connectionReference: The key an action names (e.g. shared_office365-1). connectionResource is the tenant connection it is bound to where the artefact declares it; connectionAccount is the account shown for that connection in a solution package manifest.
howToRead.masking: Credentials are replaced by [MASKED:<kind>#<sha256 first 8 hex>]. Nothing else is altered. See `maskings`.
howToRead.displayNames: displayNamesEvidenced lists only names found in the repository (connection references, package manifests) — none is supplied from outside.
